class.name: IfcCableSegment
class.brief_description: A cable segment is a flow segment used to carry electrical power, data, or telecommunications signals. A cable segment is used to typically join two sections of an electrical network or a network of components carrying the electrical service. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcCableSegment defines the occurrence of any cable segment; common information about cable segment types is
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Identifies the predefined types of cable segment from which the type required may be set. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
